name: SM_Catapult_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: catapult, 4.6 m long and 3.4 m to the counterweight: oak sill frame, two braced uprights with an iron axle, a throwing arm with a bowl, a strapped stone counterweight, a windlass with handspikes and a hauling rope
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: Built as a counterweight engine from one 260-pixel frame: the sling, release hook and trough of a real trebuchet are replaced by a fixed bowl, as the sprite shows. Timbers are bevelled blocks pushed through each other: no mortises, pegs, iron bands or bolts, and nothing turns or fires (no rig, no animation). Grain is procedural streaking along each member. One convex hull is exported for the whole engine.
